articles.title: IAS officer, booked for abusing, attacking cops at Bengaluru pub, transferred
articles.summary: Vikas Marmat, an IAS officer from Andhra Pradesh, has been transferred following an incident at a Bengaluru nightclub. This incident involved an inspection by the police to check for underage drinking.

articles.title: NYC subway hides ventilation shaft and emergency exit behind 1847 Brooklyn townhouse façade
articles.summary: Nestled at 58 Joralemon Street in Brooklyn Heights lies a historic brownstone that harbors a subway ventilation shaft beneath its surface. Established in 1847, it transformed into a vital transit hub in 1908 under the Brooklyn Rapid Transit Company.

articles.title: Lake Ringgold Reservoir Permit: Judge overturns state approval; Wichita Falls weighs appeal
articles.summary: In a significant legal development, a Texas judge has scrapped the permit for the Lake Ringgold reservoir, amidst ongoing opposition from local ranchers concerned about environmental issues and property rights. Wichita Falls aims to appeal this ruling as they push for their water supply plans.
